final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM inventory i JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rating AS rating, s1.n AS n, s1.n - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.n > s2.a) SELECT SUM(n), AVG(d) FROM s3
